bio: Welcome to Harvard! My name is Armando, and I am a first-generation college student from Southern California. I am also an Assistant Director for the Office of Community Engagement, Equity, and Belonging at Harvard Law School. I graduated with my bachelor's from the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) before earning my master's in Education Leadership, Organizations, and Entrepreneurship (ELOE) from the Harvard Graduate School of Education (HGSE). Outside of work, I enjoy traveling, hiking, and spending time with friends and family. I'm excited and look forward to welcoming you on campus!
